span.normalized: Historically, the Company sold the vast majority of its rare earth concentrate to a single, principal distributor in China under the terms of the Shenghe Offtake Agreement (as defined in Note 21, “Related-Party Transactions,” in the notes to the Consolidated Financial Statements). In July 2025, to align with the terms of the DoW Transaction Agreements and in further support of its domestic supply chain objectives, the Company ceased all sales of its products to China.
